tagline.en_US: A self-hosted dashboard with bookmarks, widgets, uptime monitoring and Proxmox integration.

description.en_US: Lastboard is a self-hosted personal dashboard designed to organize bookmarks, display widgets, and track infrastructure status. It features a customizable drag-and-drop grid layout, support for multiple independent dashboards, and built-in uptime monitoring with alerting. The application also connects to server endpoints to display resource metrics, container statuses, and Proxmox virtual machine health.
